parts.text:
How can I obtain the content of `enforcement.html` for Arkose Labs version 2.18.0? Direct access to the constructed URL gives 404. Traffic capture on Twitch didn't show the request. Is there a way to force Arkose to load, or another place to find this file?

--- КОНТЕКСТ КОДА / ОШИБКИ ---
The user wants to obtain `enforcement.html` from Arkose Labs, which is used by Twitch.
The user has `arkose.js` (api.js). Analysis of `arkose.js` shows that the URL for `enforcement.html` is constructed as:
`host + "/" + file + "?" + publicKey + "#" + host + "&" + id + "&" + parentOrigin`

Example variables from `arkose.js` and user input:
`host` = `https://client-api.arkoselabs.com`
`file` = `2.18.0/enforcement.837917397f9ce5fc720def2e31248537.html`
`publicKey` = `E5558E2B-4C90-4A61-8608-542B28B31580` (Twitch public key)

Constructed URL: `https://client-api.arkoselabs.com/2.18.0/enforcement.837917397f9ce5fc720def2e31248537.html?E5558E2B-4C90-4A61-8608-542B28B31580#https://client-api.arkoselabs.com&(UUID)&https%3A%2F%2Fwww.twitch.tv`

Accessing this URL returns 404.
Attempts to capture traffic using Playwright on `twitch.tv` and `twitch.tv/login` did not reveal requests to `enforcement.html`.
A web search found an older version hosted on another domain, but downloading it failed.
